P.instruction: Fulfill every Step 2 requirement without adding authorization semantics the user did not request.
P.value: After Gemini Step 3 PASS, create ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/work-action-approval-rulebook.json as valid JSON. The root will contain a rules array, and every rule element will contain a verbose rule identifier/name, rule text, definition, evaluation method, rule_following criteria with examples, and rule_breaking criteria with examples. Include a safe-word authorization rule stating that no action is authorized unless the user has selected a safe word and uses that selected safe word to approve the printed plan. Include an action-set-definition rule covering creation, mutation, deletion, checking, inspecting, reviewing, similar acts, and semantic pattern/shape/analogy matches. Inside that rule include 25 unique typical action examples spanning writes, deletes, moves, sends, commits, deployments, tool/API calls, reads, searches, checks, inspections, reviews, tests, evaluations, workflow runs, downloads/uploads, document operations, database queries/mutations, permission changes, and artifact generation; for every example include an evaluation explaining why it qualifies under the action definition. Include a pre-action-set-definition rule for deciding a plan, printing it to UI, and printing definitions. Include a pre-permission-plan rule requiring the complete action plan and all action/subaction/ambiguous-term definitions to be printed before permission is requested. Include an action_plan_return_schema object defining fields for plan_id, status, safe_word_required, safe_word_selected, permission_request_scope, actions, subactions, definitions, ambiguous_terms, dependencies, approval, and post_approval_change_control; each action/subaction must carry identifiers and definitions, and dependencies must map subaction_id to action_id with a required_reason. Include the post-approval immutability rule: after approval, no action or subaction may be added, and the plan may change only by removing uncompleted actions. Validate the produced JSON syntactically, commit it, read the committed file back, and report only observed completion evidence.
